claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "The Role of Superconductors in Gravity Research", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-03-23 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2010-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-1003-013. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.

claims.text: Author of record per the DIA letter of 9 January 2018, item 10: "Role of Superconductors in Gravity Research, Dr George Hathaway, Hathaway Consulting." This attribution corrects the common assumption that the paper was written by one of the academic gravity-modification claimants whose work it reviews.

The released cover page reads "23 March 2010 / ICOD: 1 December 2010 / DIA-08-1003-013," series "Acquisition Threat Support." The printed Intelligence Cut-Off Date is later than the printed publication date, which is anomalous; every other DIRD in this batch from the same March 2010 tranche carries ICOD 1 December 2009. The reading is recorded as printed and flagged.

The paper reviews the rotating-superconductor gravity-modification claims associated with Evgeny Podkletnov and the work of Ning Li. Hathaway had personally run a Podkletnov replication between 1996 and 2003 and obtained null results, so DIA commissioned the review from a researcher with a documented record of failing to reproduce the effect.
The author line on the released cover page is redacted under (b)(6); the inside cover carries the standard AAWSA FY2009 administrative note.

connections.note: DIA list item 10: "Role of Superconductors in Gravity Research, Dr George Hathaway, Hathaway Consulting." This is the attribution most likely to be got wrong from the title alone: the paper reviews the Podkletnov and Ning Li gravity-modification claims but was not written by either of them or by any academic advocate of the effect. It was written by the Toronto engineer who had run the Podkletnov replication and reported null results.
